data.name: Lulua
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Lulua means 'gentle flow' or 'smoothness'. It is a name derived from the root word 'l-l-w' which signifies 'flow' or 'movement'. In Islamic culture, this name symbolizes the gentle and continuous flow of God's mercy and blessings in one's life.
